title: Armageddon as a kinetic war against the returning Son of God
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Armageddon as a kinetic war against the returning Son of God, about future end times at Earth, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Armageddon is a war with the son of God returning to the earth. And I believe that's a kinetic war.

plain: A filmmaker and researcher named Tim Alberino, maker of a film called Birthright, tells podcast host Jesse Michels his reading of Armageddon, the final battle described in the Bible. Alberino says it is a war against the Son of God as he returns to Earth, and that he believes it will be a real, physical war fought with weapons. For him this would mean the end times are a literal conflict, not only a spiritual one.
